newsitem.title: USA: Air Wisconsin November load factor up 4.5 points.
newsitem.headline: Air Wisconsin November load factor up 4.5 points.

text.p: Air Wisconsin Airlines Corp, operating as United Express, said its November load factor rose 4.5 points to 53.6 percent.
Revenue passenger miles gained 2.5 percent to 39.2 million and available seat miles fell 6.3 percent to 73.1 million.
Year to date, the laod factor was 55.9 percent, up 2.2 points. Revenue passenger miles increased 9.8 percent to 478.4 million, and available seat miles rose 5.5 percent to 855.4 million.
